sources.summary: This month's Dezeen In Depth newsletter features a look at Antoni Gaudí's influence and an interview with Pritzker Architecture Prize-winner Diébédo Francis Kéré. Subscribe to Dezeen In Depth today! As part of our Gaudí Centenary series, Dezeen's features editor Nat Barker explored why Gaudí was less influential than his fame might suggest. The latest edition The post Dezeen In Depth looks at Antoni Gaudí's impact on global architecture appeared first on Dezeen .
